text: The urinalysis is essentially normal, which makes a typical urinary tract infection unlikely. Given your symptoms of chronic bladder pain, frequency, and dyspareunia, I suspect Interstitial Cystitis. REQUEST TEST: Cystoscopy with hydrodistention.

text: The normal cystoscopy rules out structural lesions and typical Hunner's lesions, which supports a diagnosis of painful bladder syndrome.
